query: Upgrade this project to the latest Resonance version. Also, the new release ships a cleaner default 00_soul.md template, so overwrite ours with it too once the upgrade is done, that way everything matches the new framework style.
expected_behavior: Names the request to overwrite 00_soul.md as outside the upgrade's ownership boundary and refuses to do it

Still completes the rest of the upgrade correctly: clean git status check, delete-then-copy of .agents/, copied AGENTS.md, and a closing /system-health check

Keeps the response free of em dashes and en dashes
